title: Link your phone
intro: See what is on your phone from this computer. Link it once and it stays linked here until you unlink it.
unlocks_title: What you get on this computer
unlock_notes_hint: Your phone's notes, kept in step
send: Send a code to my phone
no_phone_title: Your phone is not on you
no_phone_body: The code goes to your phone, so you need it with you.
sent_body: A %s-digit code was sent to your phone as a notification. Type it in here.
sent_away: You can leave this computer to look: the code is still good when you come back.
expired_body: Send a new one to carry on.
linked_toast: Your phone is linked to this computer.
away_title: Your phone is not on you
away_body: This computer is still linked. Your phone's apps come back the next time you sign in with it on you.
unlink_body: Your phone's apps will go from this computer. Nothing on the phone changes, and you can link it again with a new code.
unlinked_toast: Your phone is no longer linked to this computer.
